approach: The narration here is already lean: 66 words, about 24 seconds, in the opening line and the closing run after Brendan leaves. The closing five narrator lines sit together with nothing between them, so they merge into one tighter line that keeps every action, the glad-to-have-it-back feeling and the AI meme wallpaper. The opening line would save under 2 seconds, so it is left alone.

ifDeleted.summary: Brendan returns the Mac Studio and mentions the security audit. SJ, delighted, tells him about the unlocked model, reads him the first hackernews reports of the worm and says he has recommended him to a friend. Nobody realises what is sitting on the table. Most of the plot is repeated in s22 (the key, the memo, the unlocked model, the 'allowed to do' line). Deleting the scene loses Brendan's last appearance on stage and the warm dramatic irony that makes SJ's later plea for Brendan's sake land harder. One narrator bridge covers the handback.
